Naoise Nallinto is a Wood Elf courtesan working at Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing.
“
But no tale did justice to its ethereal beauty. It floats like a butterfly, its blood shimmers like silver.
„
— Naoise Nallinto commenting on the mind flayer she just saw

Overview

Naoise (standard Irish pronunciation “NEE-sha” – /ˈniːʃə/) is on the third floor of the building in her room Nymph's Grotto at X: 23 Y: 85. The party can first learn about her when entering Sharess' Caress and talking with  Mamzell Amira; she mentions that they have a "nymph", but she is currently busy with a client.

Involvement

Act Three

Upon entering the room Nymph's Grotto a cutscene begins. The player character and the client  Fist Jara have a moment of tadpole connection. Jara announces that she recognizes the player character, as the Absolute has shown her. This triggers her transformation into a  Mind Flayer and a fight begins.

Afterwards, when talking with Naoise, she expresses admiration of the mind flayer's beauty. Passing a  DC 10 Insight Check grants additional dialogue choices[verify], allowing the interacting party member to comment on her arousal towards the mind flayer. This opens up an option to the experience of her rapture.

Accepting Naoise's proposition earns the following inspiration:

  • ⁠Alternative Vocations ( Guild Artisan background)
  • ⁠Exsanguinated Ecstacy ( Haunted One background)
  • ⁠Giving a Private Performance ( Entertainer background)

Reward

Default reward:

  • Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation

If rapture is experienced:

  •  Rapture, a temporary passive buff
